releaseNotes.zh-CN:
Android Node 0.2.1（测试版）

统一所有输入框和服务地址弹窗，移除双底线，使用原生圆角边框、清晰标签与就地错误提示。
登录、注册、邮箱验证与密码找回采用一致的原生页面；页面恢复保留名称和邮箱，密码不保存。
新增 App 内账号名称与密码设置、已关联登录方式展示、退出其他登录会话。
使用指南与电脑配对指引在 App 内查看，不再打开网页控制台。
GitHub / 浏览器授权改用带 App 配色的 Custom Tab。
官方服务的邮箱验证和密码重置支持 Android App Links；开启受支持链接后可在 App 内完成。
应用图标沿用官网的 ADC 连接线标志，支持自适应形状与 Android 13 主题图标。

沿用已安装测试版的签名，可覆盖升级。Android 系统授权和第三方账号授权仍需用户确认。
releaseNotes.en:
Android Node 0.2.1 (preview)

One native rounded field treatment across forms and service dialogs, with clear labels and inline errors; removes duplicated platform underlines.
Consistent native login, registration, email verification and password recovery. Form restoration preserves name and email, never passwords.
In-app profile/password settings, linked sign-in method information and revocation of other sessions.
Native phone help and computer pairing instructions replace routine web-console navigation.
GitHub/browser authorization uses an app-themed Custom Tab.
Official service verification/reset links support verified Android App Links when supported-link handling is enabled.
The launcher uses the official ADC cable mark with adaptive shapes and Android 13 themed icon support.

Retains the installed preview certificate for in-place upgrades. System permission and third-party authorization remain under user control.
